title: Header fields: quoted keys, with and without an alias, and an unquoted name (YAML surface)
description: A quoted key is located by that key; an expression reaches it only through its alias, which also replaces its IRI's local name ("samples" as n is <base>n); "bands", with no alias, keeps the IRI <base>H.bands; the unquoted lines is located by its own name, so no bddo:key is emitted for it. The YAML mirror of the text document compiles to the same graph.
